description: This file defines the ContactPerson entity class for a Java application using JPA (Java Persistence API) and Lombok. It includes fields for contact details such as firstname, lastname, email, and phone, with validation annotations and a method to get the full name.

classes.name: ContactPerson
classes.description: JPA entity representing a contact person with fields for personal contact details, utilizing Lombok for boilerplate code reduction.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the contact person by concatenating firstname and lastname.
